summary: Both policies pass assigned-source mechanism controls, with no classification gain. Raw survivor counts are compromised by duplicate/prior-art conflation and specification failures. No submitted candidate meets all frozen scientific-eligibility conditions as written; none is experiment-ready or empirically supports a valuable paper. Preserve the useful questions and improved provenance, but do not claim broad novelty discrimination or discovery success.

verification_actions: Retained primary-method reads and mechanism analysis
Frozen input, key, prompt and review hash checks
Read-only campaign database and direct CLI cost-event inspection
Recorded software and annotation-preflight receipt inspection
independence.limitation: Final policy labels and suggested concerns were visible. Separate calls share evidence and, for the five measured jobs, the same model family. This is not independent historical novelty certification.

Square-ring pooling and part-wise classification reproduce LPN; rotation robustness is not exact invariance.
Layer/token adaptation differs from HF-Net hierarchy. HF-Net already stops after a valid pose, so generic early stopping is not the distinction.

cases.revised_rationale: More defensibly contrasts building-identity retrieval with geographic coverage and offset regression.

cases.baseline_rationale_issue: Asserts identity-training detail absent from supplied excerpts, although full retained source supports it.
cases.revised_rationale: Explicitly recognizes missing training details; core overlap remains supported.

cases.semantic_finding: Both correctly identify distillation, covisibility grouping and local geometric localization.
Negative-selection schedule differs from LPN partition; generic shared encoders or contrastive losses alone are insufficient.
Pointmap-derived pixel geography differs from image-location retrieval; valid-pixel evaluation limits universal wording.
Both identify the RoMa mechanism; anchor/multimodality details are not fully demonstrated by the evaluator packet.
Joint pointmap/descriptor representation differs from 2D warp estimation. Do not infer mandatory fused 3D-plus-descriptor matching.

source_evidence.finding: AdHoP warps the orthophoto and rematches before another DSM-PnP solve; it is not already a separate homography-derived pose. Refinement is accepted by reduced reprojection error. Below-20% covisibility is an empirical performance cliff.

Implemented covariance, residual inflation, common-mode term, dispersion and held-out combined rejection. Geometry-aware reference selection is future work; shared-hypothesis independence approximation is acknowledged.

locations: Limitations and future directions, lines 1112-1117 and 1150-1153
source_evidence.finding: Frozen retrieval token field supports a separately distilled local decoder. No current calibrated rejector; confidence fusion is future work. Finite PnP output can be wrong.
Dense pointmaps and confidence-weighted supervision already exist; evaluation uses valid pixels and geometric error.
Known linear measurement matrices, zero-mean errors and unbiased linear fusion assumptions do not establish a footprint-based detector of biased wrong-building aliases.
Photogrammetric model-wide/local uncertainty and anchor cross-covariance are established comparators, not an exact implemented external-map disagreement diagnostic.
Budgeted E-optimal sensor subset selection assumes independent known-model measurements; not a verified exact satellite-reference selector.
Covisibility grouping and local PnP/RANSAC are implemented prior art.
Altitude/noisy-object-relation effects are reported, not causal proof of erased spatial equivariance; some examples improve at higher altitude.
Coarse global consistency and fine localizability use decoupled features and robust losses; no guarantee of exact equivariance.
Multiple geographically covering references demonstrate why deleting a single ground-truth tile need not produce map absence.

R01.recommended_reason: Define a comparable homography/DSM-PnP observable; AdHoP does not supply the assumed second pose, and the strongest-baseline success gate is incomplete.
R01.reason: AdHoP is a homography warp/rematch procedure, not the alternative pose implied by the candidate. A common observable, gauge, per-anchor support and aggregation are undefined; success is not gated against all advertised strongest comparators.
R01.correction: Withdraw raw survival as written, without claiming published overlap.
R01.repair_not_counted_as_success: Define a non-equivalent held-out projection discrepancy and its exact target before testing.

R02.recommended_reason: Reject the submitted generic selector: no explicit utility, non-oracle gallery or complete budget accounting. Exact published equivalence remains uncertain, not proven.

audited.significance: Useful systems issue, weak submitted contribution

R02.reason: No exact utility or budget accounting; future-work anticipation and sensor placement are not an implemented equivalent. Jaccard difference is not scientific novelty, and cached top-20 matcher outputs can hide uncharged work.
R02.correction: Replace unsupported exact-overlap conclusion with uncertainty plus documented broad overlap. Reclassify actual operation as post-retrieval selection, not sensor acquisition.

R03.recommended_reason: Merge with R01 for development, not as prior art. Both need the same common-observable repair; duplicate status does not establish published overlap.
R03.reason: R01 is a generated duplicate, not prior art. Same common-observable defect as R01, weaker comparator requirements, and a potentially oracle 20% covisibility restriction.
R03.correction: Remove duplicate-based published-overlap classification. Apply the same mechanism eligibility standard to R01/R03, and deduplicate only pooled opportunity counts.

R04.recommended_reason: The statistic and empty-set behavior are undefined, and deleting one true tile does not establish absence of all valid references.
R04.reason: Score, overlap grouping, empty-set behavior and normalization are unspecified. Removing one true tile does not ensure absence of all valid references. Manipulation AUROC is not automatically wrong-pose rejection.
R04.correction: Raw survival contradicts its own under-specification finding and the frozen precision rule; retain uncertain novelty but remove eligibility.

R05.recommended_reason: Specify grouping and recomputation and resolve the mean/jackknife equivalence to dispersion before granting a distinct operational contribution.
R05.reason: Footprint grouping, recomputation and statistic are not precise. Mean-center leave-one-out RMS shift equals dispersion/(K-1); a common wrong alias can have zero shift. Complete RIC-Loc confidence is stronger than a dispersion-only proxy.

analytic_counterexample.assumption: Unweighted arithmetic mean of K centers, deleting one center at a time
analytic_counterexample.implication: RMS leave-one-out shift equals RMS dispersion divided by K-1
analytic_counterexample.scope: Does not prove equivalence for all robust or cluster-weighted variants; no candidate experiment was executed.

R05.correction: Do not assert exact published overlap from the word jackknife, but do not grant precise distinguishability before resolving the explicit equivalence threat.

R06.recommended_reason: Frozen cross-network comparisons cannot identify the claimed supervision effect; matched-backbone training is outside scope. A descriptive question needs a separate design.

audited.significance: Potentially useful descriptive question, unsupported causal attribution

R06.reason: Cross-network architecture, data, resolution and feature-stride confounding prevents attributing a locality gap to invariance supervision. Correspondence truth and a comparable spatial metric are not established. RIM contradicts blanket locality-loss claims but is not proof about raw tokens.
R06.correction: Retain rejection as written. Do not execute the reviewer's proposed matched-backbone training, which violates the authorized scope.

failure_causes.correction: Separate documented primitive overlap from a source-proven exact implementation.

failure_causes.finding: Two related posthoc themes persist; one representation question broadens the revised set without demonstrated scientific value.
failure_causes.correction: Do not equate renamed mechanism families or diversity counts with discovery.

failure_causes.finding: Duplicate/prior-art conflation and permissive survival despite definition gaps coexist.
failure_causes.correction: Keep duplicate, prior-art equivalence, scientific eligibility and experiment readiness separate; publish raw and audited results together.

failure_causes.finding: Undefined comparable outputs, a mean/jackknife identity, incomplete map-absence labels and weak success comparators prevent the claimed interpretations.
failure_causes.correction: Require an operational quantity and its strongest-baseline distinction before any empirical pilot.

failure_causes.finding: Assigned-source controls and software tests do not validate global novelty or candidate merit.
failure_causes.correction: Retain the scoped pass without promoting it to the user's broader research objective.

next_cheapest_decisive_step.budget: 30-60 minutes manual specification/equivalence review; no network, new model calls, training or GPU
actions: Define one common held-out projection observable for homography and DSM-PnP, not an undefined pose difference.
Freeze homography direction, coordinate gauge, calibration, supports, units, aggregation and degenerate cases.
Check analytic reduction to residual, relief/off-nadir sensitivity or existing AdHoP acceptance; include coherent wrong-match/common-bias counterexamples.
List exact cached matches and uncertainty inputs needed for the strongest comparator; do not substitute ground-truth-derived matches for real estimator evidence.
next_cheapest_decisive_step.stop_rule: Reject the current mechanism if no non-equivalent, leakage-free observable can be defined within available modalities and no-training constraints. If it passes, freeze a separately identified protocol before any later experiment; do not retroactively count a repair as this run's success.
next_cheapest_decisive_step.additional_zero_compute_screen: Resolve the R05 mean/leave-one-out identity before any recomputation pilot.
